name: academic-records-platform
description: Privacy-preserving academic record versioning and verification

scripts.benchmark:verification: npm run build:zk && npm run build:verification && node --import tsx apps/api/scripts/benchmark/verification.ts
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:zk && npm run build:contracts && npm run build:verification && npm run dev --workspace @scholarproof/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.api --env-file-if-exists=.env.zk --env-file-if-exists=.env.graph node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:zk && npm run build:contracts && npm run build:credentials && npm run build:pilot-data && tsc --project packages/verification/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project packages/credentials/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project packages/assessment/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project packages/access-matrix/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project packages/pilot-data/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project packages/cases/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project apps/api/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project apps/worker/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project apps/log/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --project tests/database/tsconfig.json && tsc --project tests/integration/tsconfig.json && tsc --project tests/browser/tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/zk/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --project tests/zk/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspace @scholarproof/api && npm run test --workspace @scholarproof/worker && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/verification && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/log && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/credentials && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/assessment && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/access-matrix && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/pilot-data && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/cases && npm run test --workspace @academic-records/zk
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:db: npm run build:zk && npm run build:verification && npm run test:db --workspace @scholarproof/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:zk && npm run build:verification && npm run build:pilot-data && npm run test:integration --workspace @scholarproof/api
scripts.pilot:setup: npm run build:pilot-data && npm run pilot:setup --workspace @scholarproof/api
scripts.log:setup: npm run build:verification && npm run setup --workspace @academic-records/log
